mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, we are looking at clear skies and 63 degrees at Fireman's Park, with a First Quarter moon expected tonight.

The Verona Police Department reported that a school bus driver was arrested for O W I on Thursday, October 15, after reports of dangerous driving. Fortunately, no injuries were reported among the students or the public.
There is plenty to do this weekend, including live music today at both Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by yoga sessions tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
On Thursday, October 15, officers arrested a school bus driver near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace for O W I.
